knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The procedure starts with a dynamic hazard check covering slips, electrical equipment, ventilation and public access. The check continues while work is underway.
The worked decision is to pause and restore safe controls when a pedestrian enters the wet work zone, which the assessor introduces as the test.
The practical is observed, and the lesson lists contamination control, interruption response and a final quality check as the things that are assessed.

practicalCriteria: Learner checks the area, surface, equipment and products, and confirms the label and SDS for each product before starting.
Learner puts on the protective equipment named on the label and sets up a ventilated work area before cleaning.
Learner cleans in the sequence high to low, clean to dirty, dry before wet, uses the label dilution and allows contact time.
Learner finishes with a clean, dry, inspected surface, stores equipment, disposes of residue by the approved route, and completes the record.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Demonstration record with surface, method, products, contact times, protection and deviations
Supervisor observation record against the criteria
stopWorkCriteria: Learner starts cleaning without explaining the surface and method
Learner continues with a cloth that is spreading soil
Learner uses a product without the protective equipment named on its label
